name: What's the difference between deck cleaning, staining, and sealing?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between deck cleaning, staining, and sealing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deck cleaning removes dirt, mildew, and grime using specialized solutions and power washing, preparing the surface for treatment. Staining adds color and UV protection, penetrating the wood fibers to enhance its natural beauty. Sealing applies a protective, often clear, barrier that repels water and prevents moisture absorption, reducing rot and cracking. The choice between staining and sealing often depends on your aesthetic preference and the level of protection needed; some products offer combined stain and sealant properties. Our team can help you select the best approach for your specific deck and local climate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleaning removes dirt; staining adds color and UV protection; sealing repels water. Some products combine stain and sealant, and the choice depends on your preference and climate.
